summary: The red-box markers of severity are all encoded correctly in a well-formed Urgent priority rule; the most consequential gap is that footnote 1's shock-likely criteria (pulse >= 100, RR > 30, confusion, weakness) are missing. The first check_for task wrongly includes hyperpigmentation and macule (fixed drug eruption features) as markers of severity. Fixed drug eruption probable and suspect drug rash possible rules are present and reasonable.
